item.title: Persistent Illegal Parking, Obstruction of Emergency Access & others' parkings, 24th November
item.description:
Residents of 2 Esmeralda Road are parking their 3 vehicles in the designated "No Parking" access way between 2 and 4 Esmeralda Road. Their vehicles are effectively occupying the entire access way and completely preventing other neighbours from accessing their back garden parkings. This access way is shared by residents of the estate & is specifically required to provide access to the rear gardens and private parking spaces of the neighbouring properties. The driveway is the only rear access route for emergency vehicles, including Fire Brigade and Ambulance services, to reach three properties on Langdon Way (numbers 4, 6 and 8). By parking three vehicles across this access way, the residents of 2 Esmeralda Road are obstructing this route and potentially preventing emergency services from reaching these properties in an emergency. Despite repeated requests from neighbouring residents to stop parking there and move their vehicles, they have refused to cooperate. On occasions, they have responded aggressively and are deliberately harassing residents of the estate.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 206, St James's Road, Bermondsey, Greater London
